mapper.insert: INSERT INTO question_record (user_id, question_id, book_id, question_seq, answer, is_correct, is_answered) VALUES (#{userId}, #{questionId}, #{bookId}, #{questionSeq}, #{answer}, #{isCorrect}, #{isAnswered})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT question_id) FROM question_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND book_id = #{bookId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM question_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND book_id = #{bookId} AND is_correct = 1
SELECT * FROM question_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND question_id = #{questionId} ORDER BY do_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT qr.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM question q2 WHERE q2.book_id = #{bookId} AND q2.id <= qr.question_id) as question_seq FROM question_record qr WHERE qr.user_id = #{userId} AND qr.book_id = #{bookId} ORDER BY qr.question_id ASC
